snippet.title: Monster Hunter Wilds – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, 2026! Pre-orders begin October 19, 2026. Wishlist Monster Hunter Wilds today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/monster-hunter-wilds-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
 
The hunt is on! In the latest entry of Capcom's Monster Hunter series, hunt massive monsters in a dynamic, ever-changing world, craft stronger gear, and uncover the mysteries of the Forbidden Lands. Hunt online or together via wireless local play, at home or on the go.
 
Monster Hunter Wilds arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 with full cross-platform play and all Free Title Updates. The massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, is also on the way. Stay tuned for more details!

#NintendoDirect #MHWilds

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
